utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds good to me—I’m happy to keep it simple on Saturday and bring whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thank you. I’ll send you the time and a short list of supplies, and we’ll keep it simple on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll bring the screwdriver set, a couple wrenches, and work gloves on Saturday. Just point me to the porch when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’ll be at the front porch on Saturday, and I really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help on Saturday—what time should I come by the front porch, and do you need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Come by the front porch at 9:00 Saturday morning. If you’ve got a hammer or a screwdriver, bring it along, and I’ll have the rest sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help check who’s available for Saturday and see if we can get enough hands for the porch repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam. Please let me know who can make it so I can keep the plan manageable and confirm the timing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I could really use the help this Saturday at the front porch. If you can bring a few basic tools, that would be a big relief.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can bring a few basic tools on Saturday and help with the front porch repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive on Saturday at the front porch—I can help for a while. Just remind me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren. If you can bring a hammer, a small screwdriver set, and maybe a couple of extension cords, that should cover the porch setup.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll be there at 9 a.m. on the front porch with a screwdriver and gloves. Thanks, Mina — I’ll help get the repair drive started.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Vik. I’ll see you there at 9 on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll be there at 9 with my toolbox and gloves. I’m glad we’re getting everyone lined up for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Rosa, thank you. I’ll keep you posted if we need anything else before Saturday.
